title: Boyhood parades and playing alto in brass bands
summary: He loved following parades as a boy and later played alto horn in the Tulane band and with old man Henry Allen's funerals and parades.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals

blocks.x: What about any parades when you were a boy? I actually heard...

Oh, well, I used to run all the parades, and all the advertisement on the... I was a band that was playing on the corner. I'd be out there. And the parades, and my mother never allowed me to follow the parades. But if they came around the neighborhood I'd follow them a block or two anyway. I used to love the music.
